# Burma Duta (ဗမာဒူတ) — Real-Time News Intelligence & Visualization for Myanmar

> Burma Duta is an autonomous real-time news intelligence platform monitoring public streams across Myanmar. Powered by Google Gemini 3.5 Flash and a multi-tool ReAct autonomous agent framework, it ingests, fact-checks, geo-tags, and categorizes crisis incidents across 330+ administrative townships in Myanmar.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Multi-Tool Agent**: Uses Google Gemini 3.5 Flash with ReAct reasoning loop to analyze chaotic Burmese news streams without human latency.
- **Fact-Checking & Credibility Scoring**: Detects rumors, clickbait, and disinformation, assigning verdicts (`VERIFIED`, `PLAUSIBLE`, `DISPUTED`, `FAKE_NEWS`, `SPAM`) and 0-100% credibility scores.
- **Geospatial Inference**: Resolves missing coordinates to Myanmar townships and coordinates using spatial ontology and Nominatim fallback.
- **Emergency Broadcast Alerting**: Dispatches life-safety alerts for natural disasters (landslides, flash floods, earthquakes) and conflict hazards.
- **Explainability**: Complete step-by-step reasoning trace (`agent_trace`) recorded for auditability and verification.

## Public Web Endpoints
- Web Dashboard: https://www.burmaduta.com
- Mobile Optimized View: https://www.burmaduta.com/mobile.html
- News Feed View: https://www.burmaduta.com/feed.html
- Community Discussions: https://www.burmaduta.com/comments.html

## Key Incident Categories
- `စစ်ရေးသတင်း` (Armed Conflict / Clashes)
- `မှုခင်းသတင်း` (Crime & Law Enforcement)
- `မတော်တဆဖြစ်မှု` (Accidents & Traffic)
- `သဘာဝဘေးအန္တရာယ်` (Natural Disasters / Hazards)
- `အထွေထွေ` (General Social & Humanitarian)

## Data Provenance
Data is synthesized, geo-tagged, and verified in real time from public citizen journalism networks and verified Myanmar media sources. All credits go to original sources.
